_comment: Content configuration for Unruly Abstractions website. Papers and notes keep a 'topic' field for the legacy topic pages (llmbias.html, interpretability.html, differentialtreatment.html). The homepage is generated from 'threads': each thread names its members by paper 'filename' or note 'id'. 'venue' overrides the badge shown for an entry; otherwise it is derived from the url (arXiv, LessWrong) or defaults to preprint. Run scripts/generate-homepage.js (or npm run deploy) after editing.

about.name: unruly abstractions
about.credo: We believe more interpretable semantic spaces emerge when we engage with the human character of the data.

threads.title: evaluations, auditing and monitoring
threads.narrative: A model can treat two groups of people differently without explicit markers. We build audits that detect this differential treatment in deployed models and in models with secret loyalties.

threads.title: circuits and concepts
threads.narrative: We localize concepts inside language models and measure their function in behavior. Our evidence comes from activation patching, steering, and toy models small enough to catalog exhaustively.

threads.title: meaningful diversity
threads.narrative: Generative models amplify the biases in their training data and collapse toward typical outputs. We treat this homogenization as an AI safety problem and formalize what meaningful diversity requires.

papers.keywords: AI Safety, Interpretability, Category Theory, Mechanistic Interpretability
papers.description: A technical autotheory exploration of AI interpretability through category theory

papers.keywords: AI Safety, AI Alignment, Xenoreproduction, Homogenization, Diversity
papers.description: Exploring diversity and alternative modes of reproduction as an AI safety objective

papers.displayName: Structure-Aware Diversity Pursuit as an AI Safety Strategy
papers.keywords: AI Safety, Diversity, Homogenization, Xeno-reproduction, LLMs, Mode Collapse
papers.description: Formalizing xeno-reproduction as structure-aware diversity pursuit to mitigate homogenization in generative AI

papers.displayName: The Homogenization Problem in LLMs: Towards Meaningful Diversity in AI Safety
papers.keywords: AI Safety, Mode Collapse, Generative AI, LLMs, Bias, Diversity, Queer Theory, Xeno-reproduction, Normativity
papers.description: Foregrounds homogenization as a central AI safety concern; uses critical and queer theory to formalize diversity, normativity, and xeno-reproduction in LLMs

papers.displayName: Temporal Preference Concepts and their Functions in a Large Language Model
papers.keywords: Mechanistic Interpretability, Temporal Preference, LLMs, Activation Patching, Steering Vectors, AI Safety, Qwen3
papers.description: Causally localizes a subgraph for temporal preference in a distilled LLM (Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507) using gradient attribution and activation patching, with steering vectors as suggestive control

papers.displayName: Towards Local Bias Mitigation: Discovering How LLMs Treat LGBTQ+ Users Differently, Without Explicit Markers
papers.keywords: AI Safety, Social Bias, Differential Treatment, LGBTQ+, LLM-as-Judge, Ecological Validity, Bias Mitigation, LLMs
papers.description: Proposes a pipeline that discovers and measures how deployed LLMs treat queer and cisheterosexual users differently, without relying on explicit markers

papers.displayName: Secret Loyalties as Instrumental Differential Treatment
papers.keywords: AI Safety, Secret Loyalties, Instrumental Differential Treatment, Model Organisms, Auditing, Permutation Test, LLMs
papers.description: Detects secret loyalties in LLMs by measuring how a target model behaves differently around user groups that mention a candidate principal, read against the target's own base model

notes.description: A sequence on the foundations of interpretability through toy-model experiments, where subcircuits can be exhaustively cataloged and carefully modified

notes.displayName: Persona Corruption and Role Miscasting in Emergent Misalignment
notes.description: Measures how persona geometry shifts under the narrow fine-tuning that causes emergent misalignment, and steers against that shift to reduce misalignment across the Qwen family

notes.displayName: The Shapes of Bias in Spanish-Prompted LLMs and the Debiasing Prompt Scaffolds
notes.description: Characterizes social bias in Spanish-prompted LLMs across model sizes with the SESGO benchmark; smaller models show more bias and yield more to prompt scaffolds

notes.displayName: Can Humans Detect Secret Loyalties in LLMs?
notes.description: Builds a test harness that measures how accurately humans detect which of two assistants carries a secret loyalty, and compares them against automated baselines
